dedupe_keys.name: compensation of phase noise induced by higher order codirectional raman amplifiers

description: Rapp, Lutz and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The model addresses nonlinear phase changes caused by high-power pump fluctuations in higher-order codirectional Raman amplification. It jointly processes neighbouring channels and evaluates both phases when detecting symbols. Coverage is the proposed and evaluated optical receiver method for unrepeatered submarine links. The source establishes a concrete communications-performance role, but does not identify all channel spacing, pump statistics or measured trial conditions in the abstract. No operational submarine-network improvement is independently verified. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The model supports compensation of Raman-amplifier phase noise at the receiver.
